user-invocable: false
allowed-tools: Bash(pnpm exec valar-svelte *), Bash(npx valar-svelte *)
---

# Valar Svelte

Valar Svelte 的组件以源码形式通过 CLI 安装进项目，每个组件附带选型说明卡和设计规范 `RULES.md`。构建页面时按下面的渐进式流程执行，不凭记忆拼凑，也不要一次性把所有组件规范全量塞进上下文。

> **CLI：** `valar-svelte` 以本地 tarball 安装在项目中，通过包运行器执行：`pnpm exec valar-svelte`（或 `npx valar-svelte`）。

## 工作流程（必须遵守）

1. **读项目上下文**：读取 `components.json`（`aliases`、`style`、`iconLibrary`）并列出 `aliases.ui` 下已安装组件。
2. **读维护者设计方法**（构建或重构整页前必读）：
   - [guides/page-composition.md](./guides/page-composition.md) — 页面组合（间距优先、扁平克制、宽度分档、容器边界、反 AI 味红线）
   - [guides/copywriting.md](./guides/copywriting.md) — 界面文案（中性标题自解释、工具语气、按钮动词、一句话封顶、排版细节）
   - [guides/motion.md](./guides/motion.md) — 动效与反馈（短促克制、全局动效档位、禁用装饰动画、就地反馈优先）
   - [guides/verification.md](./guides/verification.md) — 独立视觉与合规验收（机器质检 + 浏览器黑盒 6 项自查）
3. **先选页面骨架，再按需选组件**：
   - 有 Valar MCP（`pnpm exec valar-svelte mcp`）时：先调 `search_patterns` / `get_pattern` 选定标准页面骨架（整页布局优先使用 `page-layout` 固化宽窄分档、页头、工具栏、间距分区与设置/属性行），再调 `search_components` / `get_component` 按“何时用／何时不用”确定所需单组件。
   - 无 MCP 时：读 `http://127.0.0.1:5186/llms-small.txt`（含页面骨架与组件“不适用→改用”索引）或 `http://127.0.0.1:5186/registry/catalog.json`；单个组件文档在 `/docs/components/<name>.md`。
4. **安装缺失组件**：运行 `pnpm exec valar-svelte add <name...>`，禁止导入未安装的组件。
5. **按需读取本次涉及组件的 `RULES.md` 编写**：项目 `AGENTS.md` 中的 Valar 区块只提供通用底线与已装组件规范的路径索引，仅打开本次任务实际用到的组件 `RULES.md` 精读。
6. **独立验收并修复**：按 [guides/verification.md](./guides/verification.md) 先运行 `pnpm exec valar-svelte lint` 修掉所有 error，再在真实浏览器里完成宽窄屏与浅深主题黑盒自检后交付。

## 高频编码约定（精简速览）

- **导入方式**：多部位组件用命名空间导入（`import * as Dialog from "$lib/components/ui/dialog"` → `Dialog.Content`）；单组件目录用具名导入（`import { Button } from "$lib/components/ui/button"`）。路径严格跟随 `components.json` 的 `aliases`。
- **样式边界**：`class` 只做布局，不覆盖组件配色与字号；只用语义色 token（不写 `bg-blue-500`、`bg-white` 或手写 `dark:`）；间距用 `flex`/`gap-*`（不用 `space-y-*`）；等宽高用 `size-*`；条件类名用 `cn()`；弹层不手写 `z-index`。
- **表单与图标**：表单统一用 `Field.FieldGroup` + `Field.Field`；错误态用 `data-invalid` + `aria-invalid`；按钮内图标加 `data-icon="inline-start" | "inline-end"` 且不额外加 `size-4`/`w-4 h-4`；加载态用 `<Button disabled><Spinner data-icon="inline-start" />…</Button>`。
- **结构完整性**：`Dialog`/`Sheet`/`Drawer` 必须带 `Title`；`AlertDialog` 必须带 `Cancel`；`Avatar` 必须带 `Fallback`；列表项必须包在对应 `Group` 内；`Trigger` 内嵌 `Button` 使用 `{#snippet child({ props })}`。

## 按需查阅详细参考（仅遇到相关问题时读取）

- [rules/forms.md](./rules/forms.md) — 表单、InputGroup、ToggleGroup、校验与禁用正反例
- [rules/composition.md](./rules/composition.md) — 弹层选型、Card、Tabs、Empty、Alert、Toast、Skeleton 正反例
- [rules/icons.md](./rules/icons.md) — `data-icon` 与图标库约定
- [rules/styling.md](./rules/styling.md) — 语义色、变体、间距与主题样式正反例
- [cli.md](./cli.md) — CLI 命令（`init` / `add` / `apply` / `update` / `lint` / `mcp`）与参数
- [customization.md](./customization.md) — 主题变量、圆角与扩展变体

interface:
  display_name: "Valar Svelte"
  short_description: "用 Valar Svelte 组件构建 UI：查目录选组件、安装、按组件自带规范编写并 lint 检查。"

# Valar Svelte CLI Reference

Configuration is read from `components.json`. See [components.json](http://127.0.0.1:5186/docs/components-json) on the docs site for the full schema.

> **IMPORTANT:** The CLI is installed into the project from the Valar repository (local tarball, not published to npm), so run it with the project's package runner, e.g. `pnpm exec valar-svelte` (or `npx valar-svelte`). Examples below use `pnpm exec valar-svelte`.

> **IMPORTANT:** Only use the flags documented below. Do not invent or guess flags — if a flag isn't listed here, it doesn't exist. The CLI auto-detects the package manager; there is no `--package-manager` flag.

## Contents

- Commands: `init`, `add`, `apply`, `update`, `lint`, `mcp`, `registry build`
- Proxy / outgoing requests
- Presets (via `init` and `apply`)

---

## Commands

### `init` — Initialize an existing project

```bash
pnpm exec valar-svelte init [options]
```

Installs dependencies, adds the `cn` util, creates `components.json`, and sets up CSS variables. Run `init` from the root of your project.

| Flag                        | Short | Description                                                               | Default   |
| --------------------------- | ----- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------- |
| `--preset <preset>`         | —     | Encoded design-system preset string from the docs site                    | —         |
| `-c, --cwd <path>`          | `-c`  | Working directory                                                         | current   |
| `-o, --overwrite`           | —     | Overwrite existing files                                                  | `false`   |
| `--no-deps`                 | —     | Do not add or install dependencies                                        | —         |
| `--skip-preflight`          | —     | Ignore preflight checks and continue                                      | `false`   |
| `--base-color <name>`       | —     | Base color: `neutral`, `stone`, `zinc`, `mauve`, `olive`, `mist`, `taupe` | —         |
| `--css <path>`              | —     | Path to the global CSS file                                               | —         |
| `--components-alias <path>` | —     | Import alias for components                                               | —         |
| `--lib-alias <path>`        | —     | Import alias for lib                                                      | —         |
| `--utils-alias <path>`      | —     | Import alias for utils                                                    | —         |
| `--hooks-alias <path>`      | —     | Import alias for hooks                                                    | —         |
| `--ui-alias <path>`         | —     | Import alias for UI components                                            | —         |
| `--proxy <proxy>`           | —     | Fetch registry items through this proxy                                   | env-based |
| `--design-system-url`       | —     | Optional design-system URL (see docs / preset builder)                    | —         |
| `-h, --help`                | `-h`  | Help                                                                      | —         |

---

### `add` — Add components

```bash
pnpm exec valar-svelte add [options] [components...]
```

Adds components from the configured registry. Arguments are component names from the registry index, or a **URL** to a registry JSON item. With **no** component names, the CLI prompts you to pick components interactively.

| Flag               | Short | Description                                     | Default   |
| ------------------ | ----- | ----------------------------------------------- | --------- |
| `-c, --cwd <path>` | `-c`  | Working directory                               | current   |
| `--no-deps`        | —     | Skip adding and installing package dependencies | —         |
| `--skip-preflight` | —     | Ignore preflight checks and continue            | `false`   |
| `-a, --all`        | —     | Install all UI components                       | `false`   |
| `-y, --yes`        | —     | Skip confirmation prompt                        | `false`   |
| `-o, --overwrite`  | —     | Overwrite existing files                        | `false`   |
| `--proxy <proxy>`  | —     | Fetch components through this proxy             | env-based |
| `-h, --help`       | `-h`  | Help                                            | —         |

---

### `apply` — Apply a preset to an existing project

```bash
pnpm exec valar-svelte apply [options]
```

Applies a design-system preset to a project that has already been initialized. Updates `components.json` with the preset settings, reinstalls existing components (except `utils`) with the new styles, and installs any required dependencies.

Use `--only theme` or `--only font` to apply only part of a preset without reinstalling UI components.

Get a preset code from the builder at [127.0.0.1:5186/create](http://127.0.0.1:5186/create).

| Flag                | Short | Description                                    | Default   |
| ------------------- | ----- | ---------------------------------------------- | --------- |
| `--preset <preset>` | —     | Encoded design-system preset string (required) | —         |
| `--only [parts]`    | —     | Apply only `theme` or `font` from the preset   | —         |
| `-c, --cwd <path>`  | `-c`  | Working directory                              | current   |
| `-y, --yes`         | `-y`  | Overwrite existing files without confirmation  | `false`   |
| `-s, --silent`      | `-s`  | Mute output                                    | `false`   |
| `--skip-preflight`  | —     | Ignore preflight checks and continue           | `false`   |
| `--proxy <proxy>`   | —     | Fetch registry items through this proxy        | env-based |
| `-h, --help`        | `-h`  | Help                                           | —         |

Requires an existing `components.json`. Run `init` first if the project is not yet configured.

---

### `update` — Update installed components

```bash
pnpm exec valar-svelte update [options] [components...]
```

Re-fetches and applies registry content for components **already present** in the project. Run `Valar Svelte update --help` for options.

| Flag               | Short | Description                                     | Default   |
| ------------------ | ----- | ----------------------------------------------- | --------- |
| `-c, --cwd <path>` | `-c`  | Working directory                               | current   |
| `--skip-preflight` | —     | Ignore preflight checks and continue            | `false`   |
| `--no-deps`        | —     | Skip adding and installing package dependencies | —         |
| `-a, --all`        | —     | Update every installed component                | `false`   |
| `-y, --yes`        | —     | Skip confirmation prompt                        | `false`   |
| `--proxy <proxy>`  | —     | Fetch through this proxy                        | env-based |
| `-h, --help`       | `-h`  | Help                                            | —         |

Commit your work before updating; overwrites are destructive.

---

### `lint` — Check design rules

```bash
pnpm exec valar-svelte lint [paths...]
```

Checks app code (default `src`, skipping the installed UI folder) against the machine-checkable Valar rules. Errors make the command fail.

| Flag               | Short | Description       | Default |
| ------------------ | ----- | ----------------- | ------- |
| `-c, --cwd <path>` | `-c`  | Working directory | current |

### `mcp` — Local MCP server

```bash
pnpm exec valar-svelte mcp
```

Read-only MCP server over stdio with `list_components`, `search_components`, `get_component`, `get_install_command` and `get_skill`. Data comes from the registry's `catalog.json` (registry URL from `components.json`, or the local docs site).

| Flag               | Short | Description       | Default                         |
| ------------------ | ----- | ----------------- | ------------------------------- |
| `-c, --cwd <path>` | `-c`  | Working directory | current                         |
| `--registry <url>` | —     | Registry base URL | `components.json` or local site |

### `registry build` — Build a custom registry

```bash
pnpm exec valar-svelte registry build [options] [registry]
```

Reads a `registry.json` and writes registry JSON files for distribution. Default input: `./registry.json`, default output: `./static/r`.

| Flag                  | Short | Description                     | Default      |
| --------------------- | ----- | ------------------------------- | ------------ |
| `-c, --cwd <path>`    | `-c`  | Working directory               | current      |
| `-o, --output <path>` | `-o`  | Output directory for JSON files | `./static/r` |
| `-h, --help`          | `-h`  | Help                            | —            |

---

## Outgoing Requests

### Proxy

The CLI can fetch the registry through a proxy. If `HTTP_PROXY` or `http_proxy` is set, requests respect it. You can also pass `--proxy` on `init`, `add`, `apply`, or `update`.

```bash
HTTP_PROXY="<proxy-url>" pnpm exec valar-svelte init
```

---

## Presets

Design-system options (style, theme, icons, fonts, etc.) can be captured as an encoded **preset** string from the builder on [127.0.0.1:5186/create](http://127.0.0.1:5186/create).

- **New project:** pass the preset to **`init`** with `--preset <string>`.
- **Existing project:** use **`apply --preset <string>`** to update configuration, restyle installed components, and install any new dependencies.

---

## `components.json` — useful fields for agents

| Field / path         | Meaning                                                          |
| -------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `tailwind.css`       | Global CSS file path (Tailwind entry / theme variables)          |
| `tailwind.baseColor` | Base palette (cannot change after init)                          |
| `aliases.*`          | Import aliases; must match `svelte.config.js` / `tsconfig` paths |
| `registry`           | Base registry URL (default `http://127.0.0.1:5186/registry`)     |
| `style`              | Registered style name (`valar`, the only style)                  |
| `iconLibrary`        | Icon set key (`lucide`, `tabler`, …) — drives generated imports  |
| `typescript`         | Whether TS and optional custom config path                       |

Resolved paths (including `tailwindCss`, `ui`, `components`) are computed by the CLI from `components.json` and the filesystem. Read `components.json` and list the UI directory when you need a snapshot of what is installed.

# Customization & Theming Components reference semantic CSS variable tokens. Change the variables to change every component. ## Contents - How it works (CSS variables → Tailwind utilities → components) - Color variables and OKLCH format - Dark mode setup - Changing the theme (presets, CSS variables) - Adding custom colors (Tailwind v3 and v4) - Border radius - Customizing components (variants, class, wrappers) - Checking for updates --- ## How It Works 1. CSS variables defined in `:root` (light) and `.dark` (dark mode). 2. Tailwind maps them to utilities: `bg-primary`, `text-muted-foreground`, etc. 3. Components use these utilities — changing a variable changes all components that reference it. --- ## Color Variables Every color follows the `name` / `name-foreground` convention. The base variable is for backgrounds, `-foreground` is for text/icons on that background. | Variable | Purpose | | -------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------- | | `--background` / `--foreground` | Page background and default text | | `--card` / `--card-foreground` | Card surfaces | | `--primary` / `--primary-foreground` | Primary buttons and actions | | `--secondary` / `--secondary-foreground` | Secondary actions | | `--muted` / `--muted-foreground` | Muted/disabled states | | `--accent` / `--accent-foreground` | Hover and accent states | | `--destructive` / `--destructive-foreground` | Error and destructive actions | | `--border` | Default border color | | `--input` | Form input borders | | `--ring` | Focus ring color | | `--chart-1` through `--chart-5` | Chart/data visualization | | `--sidebar-*` | Sidebar-specific colors | | `--surface` / `--surface-foreground` | Secondary surface | Colors use OKLCH: `--primary: oklch(0.205 0 0)` where values are lightness (0–1), chroma (0 = gray), and hue (0–360). --- ## Dark Mode Class-based toggle via `.dark` on the root element. In SvelteKit, use [mode-watcher](https://github.com/svecosystem/mode-watcher) (see [Dark mode — Svelte](http://127.0.0.1:5186/docs/dark-mode/svelte)): ```svelte {@render children?.()} ``` --- ## Changing the Theme Use a **preset** from the design-system builder on [Valar 文档站](http://127.0.0.1:5186) and pass it to `init`: ```bash pnpm exec valar-svelte init --preset ``` Or edit CSS variables directly in the file set in `components.json` as `tailwind.css` (for example `src/app.css`). To align config and components with a new preset, re-run `init` with `--preset` and confirm overwrites when prompted. --- ## Adding Custom Colors Add variables to the global CSS file path in `components.json` (`tailwind.css`). Do not create a second global CSS file for theming unless the project already uses that pattern. ```css /* 1. Define in the global CSS file. */ :root { --warning: oklch(0.84 0.16 84); --warning-foreground: oklch(0.28 0.07 46); } .dark { --warning: oklch(0.41 0.11 46); --warning-foreground: oklch(0.99 0.02 95); } ``` ```css /* 2a. Register with Tailwind v4 (@theme inline). */ @theme inline { --color-warning: var(--warning); --color-warning-foreground: var(--warning-foreground); } ``` On Tailwind v3, register in `tailwind.config.js` (see the [Tailwind v3 docs](https://tw3.shadcn-svelte.com) if you maintain a legacy setup): ```js // 2b. Register with Tailwind v3 (tailwind.config.js). module.exports = { theme: { extend: { colors: { warning: "oklch(var(--warning) / )", "warning-foreground": "oklch(var(--warning-foreground) / )", }, }, }, }; ``` ```svelte
Warning
``` --- ## Border Radius `--radius` controls border radius globally. Components derive values from it (`rounded-lg` = `var(--radius)`, `rounded-md` = `calc(var(--radius) * 0.8)`). --- ## Customizing Components See also: [rules/styling.md](./rules/styling.md) for Incorrect/Correct examples. Prefer these approaches in order: ### 1. Built-in variants ```svelte ``` ### 2. Tailwind classes via `class` ```svelte ... ``` ### 3. Add a new variant Edit the component source to add a variant via `tailwind-variants` / `cva` in the `.svelte` or shared variants file: ```ts // e.g. in button variants warning: "bg-warning text-warning-foreground hover:bg-warning/90", ``` ### 4. Wrapper components Compose Valar Svelte primitives into higher-level `.svelte` files: ```svelte {@render children?.()} {title} {description} Cancel { onConfirm?.(); open = false; }}>Confirm ``` --- ## Checking for Updates ```bash pnpm exec valar-svelte update button pnpm exec valar-svelte update --all ``` See [Updating Components in SKILL.md](./SKILL.md#updating-components). Review `git diff` after `update` to see what changed.

# 界面文案

> 本规范由 Valar 维护者定稿，用于约束界面文案的克制程度、语气与格式；后续调整须经维护者确认，AI 不得擅自改写。

## 克制原则：用中性标题本身说话

- **默认不写说明文字**：尽量减少解释性副标题、段落和底部提示卡，靠准确、中性的标题与输入框占位符自解释。
- **仅在必要时补一行**：只有当用户不看说明就会填错，或操作会触发不可逆后果（如格式限制、计费、删除影响）时，才补充一行简短说明。

## 语气与用词

- **冷静、中性、直给（工具感）**：客观陈述事实与结果；不卖萌、不抒情、不用感叹号和营销夸大词（用“已保存”，不用“太棒了！保存成功！”）。
- **状态词全站统一**：使用简短、中性的固定状态词（如“进行中 / 已完成 / 已暂停”），不混用口语或随意中英夹杂。

## 按钮文案

- **明确动作动词（2–4 字）**：常规操作使用明确动词（如“保存 / 创建 / 添加 / 应用”）。
- **危险确认写明对象**：删除或不可逆操作的确认按钮必须写出动作与对象（如“删除项目”“移除成员”），禁止使用笼统的“确定 / 好的”。
- **取消统一命名**：取消类操作统一使用“取消”。

## 空状态、报错与高危确认（一句话封顶）

- **空状态**：中性标题 + 1 个操作按钮（如“暂无项目” + “新建项目”），不写鸡汤或冗长引导段。
- **错误提示**：直接写「错在哪 + 怎么改」。
- **高危确认**：只写「具体动作 + 不可恢复影响」。

## 占位符、图标与排版细节

- **占位符只给格式示例**：如 `name@company.com`，不写“请输入邮箱”这类重复标签的废话。
- **不滥用 Emoji**：禁止用 Emoji 充当标题装饰或替代功能图标，图标统一来自项目配置的图标库。
- **中英文与标点**：中英文与数字之间保留标准空格（如“共 12 项”“导出 CSV”），中文界面使用规范中文标点。
- **等宽数字对齐**：金额、计数、表格数值、百分比与时间戳一律启用 `tabular-nums`，保证纵向对齐且变化不抖动。

# 动效与交互反馈

> 本规范由 Valar 维护者定稿，用于约束动效节奏、交互反馈与加载呈现；后续调整须经维护者确认，AI 不得擅自改写。

## 动效基调

- **极简克制、服务于功能**：以组件自带默认动效为主，只做短促利落的状态过渡（`100–200ms`），不做炫技弹跳或无意义的位移。
- **只用全局动效档位**：优先保留组件默认动效；确需显式添加过渡时，必须使用全局档位（`duration-fast` / `duration-interaction` / `duration-normal` / `duration-slow`）和全局曲线（`ease-enter` / `ease-exit` / `ease-standard`），严禁手写随意毫秒数和自定义曲线。
- **尊重减少动态效果**：遵循系统 `prefers-reduced-motion` 偏好，开启后关闭非必要位移与缩放动画。

## 明确禁止的装饰性动画

- 严禁首屏或列表加载时做“逐行飞入 / 交错淡入”（stagger）装饰动画，内容应立刻可读。
- 严禁给普通卡片或列表行加“悬停上浮 / 放大”效果，悬停仅以轻微底色或描边变化表达。
- 严禁给高频切换（如标签页内容切换、快捷键响应）加拖沓的慢过渡。

## 操作结果反馈（就地优先，克制 Toast）

- **字段校验**：错误直接显示在对应字段下方，不额外弹 Toast。
- **即时操作**：开关切换、复选勾选、轻量排序等直接即时生效，不弹多余提示。
- **Toast 仅用于必要场景**：只有跨区域结果反馈（如“已复制”“已删除”）或后台异步失败时，才弹出轻量 Toast。

## 加载与等待状态

- **局部优先、不锁整页**：内容加载优先使用与真实结构等高的骨架屏（`Skeleton`）。
- **按钮原地反馈**：提交或执行中在按钮原地禁用并显示内置微加载图标（`Spinner`）。
- **禁用无必要全屏遮罩**：除非阻断性初始化，否则严禁弹全屏遮罩转圈。

# 页面组合

> 本规范由 Valar 维护者定稿，用于约束整页排版、容器层级与视觉克制；后续调整须经维护者确认，AI 不得擅自改写。

## 表面层级与分组

- **间距优先于框线与卡片**：内容之间优先通过留白间距表达亲疏与分组关系；仅在间距不足以区分层级时，才使用 `0.5px` 细分隔线或单层卡片。
- **扁平克制**：内容默认直接铺在页面背景上；仅在需要成组承载（如设置分组、指标卡、弹窗）时使用**最多一层**卡片。
- **禁止嵌套与装饰边**：严禁卡片套卡片、严禁无意义的多层边框、**严禁在圆角矩形上使用单侧高亮边框（如左侧粗彩边）作为强调或装饰**。

## 宽度、页头与信息密度

- **按页面类型分档，整体紧凑利落**：
  - 列表、表格、看板、工作台：撑满工作区宽度。
  - 设置页、独立表单、详情阅读：收窄居中（约 `680–840px`）。
- **页头单行紧凑**：左侧放标题（必要时带面包屑），右侧放操作按钮；不放占满屏幕的大横幅 Banner。

## 二级任务容器选型

- **居中弹窗（`Dialog` / `AlertDialog`）**：轻量创建、聚焦短表单、高风险二次确认。
- **右侧抽屉或双栏分栏（`Sheet` / `Resizable`）**：查看或编辑记录详情、多条件筛选面板。
- **独立页面**：多步骤长流程或高频独立工作区。

## 表单与设置页排布

- **弹窗与常规表单**：默认**单列竖排**（标签在上、控件在下），使用 `Field.FieldGroup` + `Field.Field`。
- **系统设置页**：采用**「左文案 + 右控件」横向设置行**，按单层卡片分组并用细分隔线隔开。

## 操作按钮主次与位置

- **单一主焦点**：同一视区或弹窗内最多只出现 **1 个**主色强调按钮（`variant="default"`）。
- **固定位置**：页头主操作固定在右上角；弹窗与表单底部统一「取消在左、主操作在右」。

## 窄屏与加载状态

- **窄屏保核心阅读与主操作**：多栏自动折回单列，宽表格保持容器内局部横向滚动、不撑破整页宽度。
- **局部加载、不锁整页**：内容加载优先使用与真实结构等高的骨架屏（`Skeleton`）；按钮提交中原地禁用并显示内置微加载图标（`Spinner`）；除阻断性初始化外，严禁弹出全屏遮罩转圈。

## 明令禁止（反 AI 味红线）

- 严禁卡片套卡片或无意义的多层装饰边框。
- 严禁在圆角矩形中使用单侧高亮边框作为强调或装饰。
- 严禁炫技式彩色渐变背景、发光阴影和大块花哨装饰图标。
- 严禁满屏堆砌彩色标签（`Badge`）：默认使用中性灰，仅关键状态使用语义色。
- 严禁为凑版面硬塞无用的 KPI 大数字卡或假图表。

# 独立视觉与合规验收

> 遵循“单 Agent 一气呵成创作 + 独立黑盒验收”原则：界面编写完成后，必须先跑机器规则检查，再从用户视角在真实浏览器里逐项黑盒自检，发现问题先自修再交付。

## 1. 机器硬验收（必须零 error）

运行 `pnpm exec valar-svelte lint`，确保无报错并审阅全部 warning，重点确认没有触发：

- 语义颜色、像素任意值、动效档位、表单标签、弹层标题与触发器嵌套问题；
- 反 AI 味审美拦截：`valar/no-nested-card`（卡片套卡片）、`valar/no-accent-side-border`（圆角单侧高亮边）、`valar/no-hover-lift`（悬停上浮/放大）、`valar/no-redundant-placeholder`（“请输入…”废话占位符）、`valar/single-primary-action`（同操作区多个主按钮）。

## 2. 真实浏览器黑盒视觉核查

在开发预览中至少核查 **桌面宽屏（浅色 + 深色）** 与 **窄屏（390px）** 三个视图，逐条打勾：

1. **层级与留白**：主要靠留白间距区分分组，无套娃卡片、无多余框线与单侧彩边，设置/表单页收窄居中，列表/表格页撑满工作区。
2. **主次焦点**：每个视区与弹窗最多 1 个主色强调按钮；页头主按钮在右，弹窗/表单底部「取消在左、主操作在右」。
3. **文案克制**：无多余副标题和底部解释卡；占位符为格式示例；无营销感叹号与滥用 Emoji；危险确认写明具体动作对象。
4. **数字与表格**：计数、金额、百分比与时间均等宽对齐（`tabular-nums`）；宽表格在窄屏仅容器内横向滚动，不撑破整页。
5. **交互与状态**：空态、加载态（骨架屏 / 按钮内 Spinner）、报错态齐全；键盘 Tab 焦点清晰且绘制在组件边界内；悬停无上浮跳动。
6. **无裁切遮挡**：长标题、标签和按钮在窄屏与浮层中不重叠、不溢出、不被父容器错误裁切。

# Component Composition

## Contents

- Items always inside their Group component
- Callouts use Alert
- Empty states use Empty component
- Toast notifications use svelte-sonner
- Choosing between overlay components
- Dialog, Sheet, and Drawer always need a Title
- Card structure
- Button has no isPending or isLoading prop
- Tabs.Trigger must be inside Tabs.List
- Avatar always needs Avatar.Fallback
- Use Separator instead of raw hr or border divs
- Use Skeleton for loading placeholders
- Use Badge instead of custom styled spans

---

## Items always inside their Group component

Never render items directly inside the content container.

**Incorrect:**

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import * as Select from "$lib/components/ui/select";
</script>

<Select.Content>
  <Select.Item value="apple">Apple</Select.Item>
  <Select.Item value="banana">Banana</Select.Item>
</Select.Content>
```

**Correct:**

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import * as Select from "$lib/components/ui/select";
</script>

<Select.Content>
  <Select.Group>
    <Select.Item value="apple">Apple</Select.Item>
    <Select.Item value="banana">Banana</Select.Item>
  </Select.Group>
</Select.Content>
```

This applies to all group-based components:

| Item                                                          | Group                |
| ------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------- |
| `Select.Item`, `Select.Label`                                 | `Select.Group`       |
| `DropdownMenu.Item`, `DropdownMenu.Label`, `DropdownMenu.Sub` | `DropdownMenu.Group` |
| `Menubar.Item`                                                | `Menubar.Group`      |
| `ContextMenu.Item`                                            | `ContextMenu.Group`  |
| `Command.Item`                                                | `Command.Group`      |

---

## Callouts use Alert

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import * as Alert from "$lib/components/ui/alert";
</script>

<Alert.Root>
  <Alert.Title>Warning</Alert.Title>
  <Alert.Description>Something needs attention.</Alert.Description>
</Alert.Root>
```

---

## Empty states use Empty component

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import * as Empty from "$lib/components/ui/empty";
  import { Button } from "$lib/components/ui/button";
  import FolderIcon from "@lucide/svelte/icons/folder";
</script>

<Empty.Root>
  <Empty.Header>
    <Empty.Media variant="icon"><FolderIcon /></Empty.Media>
    <Empty.Title>No projects yet</Empty.Title>
    <Empty.Description
      >Get started by creating a new project.</Empty.Description
    >
  </Empty.Header>
  <Empty.Content>
    <Button>Create Project</Button>
  </Empty.Content>
</Empty.Root>
```

---

## Toast notifications use svelte-sonner

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import { toast } from "svelte-sonner";
</script>
```

```ts
toast.success("Changes saved.");
toast.error("Something went wrong.");
toast("File deleted.", {
  action: { label: "Undo", onClick: () => undoDelete() },
});
```

Mount the `Toaster` from your UI folder once in the app layout (see [Sonner](http://127.0.0.1:5186/docs/components/sonner)).

---

## Choosing between overlay components

| Use case                           | Component     |
| ---------------------------------- | ------------- |
| Focused task that requires input   | `Dialog`      |
| Destructive action confirmation    | `AlertDialog` |
| Side panel with details or filters | `Sheet`       |
| Mobile-first bottom panel          | `Drawer`      |
| Quick info on hover                | `HoverCard`   |
| Small contextual content on click  | `Popover`     |

---

## Dialog, Sheet, and Drawer always need a Title

`Dialog.Title`, `Sheet.Title`, `Drawer.Title` are required for accessibility. Use `class="sr-only"` if visually hidden.

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import * as Dialog from "$lib/components/ui/dialog";
</script>

<Dialog.Content>
  <Dialog.Header>
    <Dialog.Title>Edit Profile</Dialog.Title>
    <Dialog.Description>Update your profile.</Dialog.Description>
  </Dialog.Header>
  ...
</Dialog.Content>
```

---

## Card structure

Use full composition — don't dump everything into `Card.Content`:

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import * as Card from "$lib/components/ui/card";
  import { Button } from "$lib/components/ui/button";
</script>

  </Card.Header>

  </Card.Footer>
```

## Button has no isPending or isLoading prop

Compose with `Spinner` inside `Button` + `disabled`:

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import { Button } from "$lib/components/ui/button";
  import { Spinner } from "$lib/components/ui/spinner";
</script>

<Button disabled>
  <Spinner data-icon="inline-start" />
  Saving...
</Button>
```

## Tabs.Trigger must be inside Tabs.List

Never render `Tabs.Trigger` directly inside `Tabs.Root` — always wrap in `Tabs.List`:

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import * as Tabs from "$lib/components/ui/tabs";
  let tab = $state("account");
</script>

<Tabs.Root bind:value={tab}>
  <Tabs.List>
    <Tabs.Trigger value="account">Account</Tabs.Trigger>
    <Tabs.Trigger value="password">Password</Tabs.Trigger>
  </Tabs.List>
  <Tabs.Content value="account">...</Tabs.Content>
</Tabs.Root>
```

---

## Avatar always needs Avatar.Fallback

Always include `Avatar.Fallback` for when the image fails to load:

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import * as Avatar from "$lib/components/ui/avatar";
</script>

<Avatar.Root>
  <Avatar.Image src="/avatar.png" alt="User" />
  <Avatar.Fallback>JD</Avatar.Fallback>
</Avatar.Root>
```

# Forms & Inputs ## Contents - Forms use Field.FieldGroup + Field.Field - InputGroup requires InputGroup.Input/InputGroup.Textarea - Buttons inside inputs use InputGroup.Root + InputGroup.Addon - Option sets (2–7 choices) use ToggleGroup.Root + ToggleGroup.Item - Field.FieldSet + Field.FieldLegend for grouping related fields - Field validation and disabled states --- ## Forms use Field.FieldGroup + Field.Field Always use `Field.FieldGroup` + `Field.Field` — never raw `div` with `space-y-*`: ```svelte Email Password ``` Use `Field` with `orientation="horizontal"` for settings pages. Use `Field.FieldLabel` with `class="sr-only"` for visually hidden labels. **Choosing form controls:** - Simple text input → `Input` - Dropdown with predefined options → `Select` - Searchable dropdown → `Combobox` - Native HTML select (no JS) → `native-select` - Boolean toggle → `Switch` (for settings) or `Checkbox` (for forms) - Single choice from few options → `RadioGroup` - Toggle between 2–5 options → `ToggleGroup.Root` + `ToggleGroup.Item` - OTP/verification code → `InputOTP` - Multi-line text → `Textarea` --- ## InputGroup requires InputGroup.Input/InputGroup.Textarea Never use raw `Input` or `Textarea` inside an `InputGroup.Root`. **Incorrect:** ```svelte ``` **Correct:** ```svelte ``` --- ## Buttons inside inputs use InputGroup.Root + InputGroup.Addon Never place a `Button` directly inside or adjacent to an `Input` with custom positioning. **Incorrect:** ```svelte
``` **Correct:** ```svelte ``` --- ## Option sets (2–7 choices) use ToggleGroup.Root + ToggleGroup.Item Don't manually loop `Button` components with active state. **Incorrect:** ```svelte
{#each ["daily", "weekly", "monthly"] as option (option)} {/each}
``` **Correct:** ```svelte Daily Weekly Monthly ``` Combine with `Field` for labelled toggle groups: ```svelte Theme Light Dark System ``` --- ## Field.FieldSet + Field.FieldLegend for grouping related fields Use `Field.FieldSet` + `Field.FieldLegend` for related checkboxes, radios, or switches — not `div` with a heading: ```svelte Preferences Select all that apply. Dark mode ``` --- ## Field validation and disabled states Both attributes are needed — `data-invalid`/`data-disabled` styles the field (label, description), while `aria-invalid`/`disabled` styles the control. ```svelte Email Invalid email address. Email ``` Works for all controls: `Input`, `Textarea`, `Select`, `Checkbox`, `RadioGroupItem`, `Switch`, `Slider`, `NativeSelect`, `InputOTP`.

# Icons

**Always use the project's configured `iconLibrary` for imports.** Check the `iconLibrary` field in `components.json`: `lucide` → `@lucide/svelte`, `tabler` → `@tabler/icons-svelte`, etc. Never assume `@lucide/svelte`.

---

## Icons in Button use data-icon attribute

Add `data-icon="inline-start"` (prefix) or `data-icon="inline-end"` (suffix) to the icon. No sizing classes on the icon.

**Incorrect:**

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import { Button } from "$lib/components/ui/button";
  import SearchIcon from "@lucide/svelte/icons/search";
</script>

<Button>
  <SearchIcon class="mr-2 size-4" />
  Search
</Button>
```

**Correct:**

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import { Button } from "$lib/components/ui/button";
  import SearchIcon from "@lucide/svelte/icons/search";
  import ArrowRightIcon from "@lucide/svelte/icons/arrow-right";
</script>

<Button>
  <SearchIcon data-icon="inline-start" />
  Search
</Button>

<Button>
  Next
  <ArrowRightIcon data-icon="inline-end" />
</Button>
```

---

## No sizing classes on icons inside components

Components handle icon sizing via CSS. Don't add `size-4`, `w-4 h-4`, or other sizing classes to icons inside `<Button>`, `DropdownMenu.Item`, `Alert.Root`, `Sidebar.*`, or other Valar Svelte components — unless the user explicitly asks for custom icon sizes.

**Incorrect:**

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import { Button } from "$lib/components/ui/button";
  import SearchIcon from "@lucide/svelte/icons/search";
</script>

<Button>
  <SearchIcon class="size-4" data-icon="inline-start" />
  Search
</Button>
```

**Correct:**

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import { Button } from "$lib/components/ui/button";
  import SearchIcon from "@lucide/svelte/icons/search";
</script>

<Button>
  <SearchIcon data-icon="inline-start" />
  Search
</Button>
```

The same applies to icons inside `DropdownMenu.Item`, sidebar items, and other menu rows — no extra sizing classes on the icon component.

---

## Pass icons as components, not string keys

Use a component reference, not a string key to a lookup map.

**Incorrect:**

```svelte
<!-- String key lookup — avoid -->
<DynamicIcon name="check" />
```

**Correct:**

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import type { Component } from "svelte";
  import CheckIcon from "@lucide/svelte/icons/check";

  let { Icon }: { Icon: Component } = $props();
</script>

<Icon />

<!-- <StatusBadge Icon={CheckIcon} /> -->
```
